scope: ELMOS source, CI workflow, declared dependencies, build runners, release artifacts, and Batch 40 evidence

threats.evidenceRequirement: protected-branch policy and reviewed merge receipt

trustBoundaries: repository workflow to third-party GitHub Action
controls: full commit pin for every external Action

GitHub-hosted token issuance is externally operated and not independently attested here.

threats.evidenceRequirement: resolved graph, advisory snapshot, license and integrity decisions

threats.evidenceRequirement: working-tree and history scan with provider validation

trustBoundaries: workflow label to GitHub-hosted runner image
threats.evidenceRequirement: runtime runner-image attestation and downgrade rejection receipt

threats.evidenceRequirement: real signed artifact, transparency or trust-root record, and verification receipt

threats.evidenceRequirement: SLSA provenance from an isolated builder and independent verification

trustBoundaries: tenant execution to shared evidence store

threats.evidenceRequirement: independent corpus, immutable raw results, and signed certification request
